title: Open-World Biome and LPC Intake Normalization
changes: Replaced the static farmstead client default with a generated Willowmere-outskirts open-world biome region.
Removed baked farm, tavern, field, greenhouse, bridge, placeholder-object, and outdoor-portal assumptions from the default exterior scene.
Added explicit city, rural-business, and open-world player-building placement policy.
Made pack-defined default scenes authoritative and allowed open-world packs to opt out of legacy farmstead scene requirements.
Restricted the active exterior biome to one reviewed LPC summer terrain family and isolated terrain-v7 farm/highland art as diagnostic-only pending family audits.
Added an audited intake queue for additional OpenGameArt LPC terrain, mountain, water, bridge, farm, and city-street candidates.
Pixel-snapped the runtime terrain origin and normalized direct source-cell submission to exact logical tile dimensions.
Updated terrain certification, materialization, topology, and client-pack contracts for the open-world foundation.
